metadata.review_scope: Phase 1 governance gate determinism, schemas, validator behavior only

findings.evidence: The governance fixture command completed with total=21 passed=19 failed=2. Case 06 expected exit 2 but returned exit 1 with 27 structural errors; case 07 at line 87 expected exit 2 but returned exit 1 with 3 structural errors. The suite itself therefore exits 1 at line 123.
findings.reproduction: From the product root run: node .codex/tests/run-governance-fixtures.mjs. Observe FAIL 06, FAIL 07, and GOV​ERNANCE_FIXTURES total=21 passed=19 failed=2 (the zero-width character in this evidence label is descriptive only; the actual command output label is GOVERNANCE_FIXTURES).
findings.impact: The checked-in deterministic governance regression suite is red, so Phase 1 cannot claim a passing formal governance gate baseline even though both cases fail closed. The distinction between a valid policy NO-GO (exit 2) and malformed evidence (exit 1) is not regression-proven for reviewer-session collision and pending approval.

program_recomputes_gate.evidence: .codex/scripts/validate-task.mjs:294 computes GO only when both structural errors and gate reasons are empty; lines 313 and 319-323 map the computed result to the process exit.

manual_overall_calculated_final_summary_.evidence: .codex/scripts/validate-task.mjs:294-310 recomputes the gate before comparing declared overall/calculated/final-summary values and derives task-graph solely from traceability. Fixture 17 rejects a forged manual gate with exit 1. A stale graph is rejected, not used as a gate input.

blocker_dominance.evidence: .codex/scripts/validate-task.mjs:251-257 and 275 convert review BLOCKER and top-level blockers into NO-GO reasons. Fixture 02 returned exit 2 and NO-GO.

missing_reviewer_run_session_evidence_ha.evidence: Fixtures 04, 08, 10, 20 and 21 fail closed; .codex/scripts/validate-task.mjs:261-281 enforces required review identity, session independence, and final approval. The live GOV-M320-DRYRUN run reported missing formal reviewer identities and pending final approval and returned exit 2. Condition: fixture 06 and 07 exit-class assertions are failing as recorded in CR-A-BLOCKER-001.

l1_l2_l3_minimums_validator_decided.evidence: .codex/scripts/validate-task.mjs:241-247 unions declared reviews with automatic level-triggered reviews; lines 265-281 add L3 identity, session, and approval requirements. L3 behavior is exercised extensively, while the checked-in suite does not contain complete positive/negative L1 and L2 task fixtures.

ten_schemas_applied.evidence: .codex/scripts/validate-task.mjs:14-25 maps nine task artifacts to schemas; validateTask loads and applies them before gating, and loadRuleRegistry applies rule.schema.json to every Meta and Domain Rule. This totals the ten supplied schemas.

empty_arrays_unknown_enum_placeholders_r.evidence: .codex/scripts/lib/schema-validator.mjs:22 and 29-32 enforce enums and minItems; review-findings.schema.json:6 requires at least one review; .codex/scripts/validate-task.mjs:160-174 rejects TBD, TODO, PLACEHOLDER, and <TASK-ID>. Fixtures 09, 18, 19, and 21 returned exit 1.

exit_codes_0_1_2.evidence: .codex/scripts/validate-task.mjs:313 defines 0=valid GO, 1=structural error, 2=valid NO-GO. Fixtures demonstrate all three and the live dry-run returned structural=VALID exit=2. Condition: the full regression suite exits 1 because cases 06 and 07 disagree with their expected class.

create_task_draft_no_go.evidence: .codex/scripts/create-task.mjs:96-104 creates DRAFT evidence, non-formal unresolved reviews, pending L3 approval, NO-GO summaries, and reports status=DRAFT calculated_gate=NO-GO.

task_graph_cannot_reverse_gate.evidence: .codex/scripts/validate-task.mjs:284-313 validates traceability, computes the gate first, and only then compares or writes the deterministic graph; graph content is never read as a gate-authority input.

gov_m320_live_validation.evidence: node .codex/scripts/validate-task.mjs --task-id GOV-M320-DRYRUN returned calculated_gate=NO-GO structural=VALID exit=2 with candidate Rule, failed evidence, compatibility BLOCKER, missing formal reviewer identity, open conditions/blockers, and pending final approval reasons.

governance_fixture_suite.evidence: node .codex/tests/run-governance-fixtures.mjs returned total=21 passed=19 failed=2 and process exit 1.

limitations: Review was restricted to AGENTS.md, .codex/**, .agents/**, GOV-M320-DRYRUN, and the evidence paths declared by its manifest; no .env*, frontend, erp-api, db-design, migration, service, product test, database, or Git mutation was performed.
No source file was modified and no task graph was rewritten. Governance fixtures used their own temporary tree and cleaned it up.
The checked-in fixture suite has comprehensive L3 coverage but does not provide complete end-to-end L1 and L2 positive/negative task fixtures, so their minimum-level behavior was assessed statically.
The artifact outcome is BLOCKER because a formal baseline suite is failing, not because fail-closed behavior was bypassed; both failed cases returned the stricter structural-error exit 1.
